title: PageData
description: Cross-stack page-to-page data transfer protocol. Supports passing arbitrary data between pages during navigation, independent of URL query parameters.

dataId.description: Unique identifier for this data transfer, used by the target page to retrieve the data

source.description: Tech stack that sent this data

target.description: Tech stack intended to receive this data

route.description: The route URL being navigated to (e.g., app://rn/detail?id=123)

data.description: Arbitrary JSON data to pass to the target page

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the data was created

ttl.description: Time to live in milliseconds. Data expires after this duration. Default: 300000 (5 minutes)
